title: Heuristic fusion scheduler for mixed-turns memory defrag and KV prefetching
creator: Marcus Li
description: Problem: Mixed prompt/response workloads (short prompts with long generations and vice versa) cause high KV cache churn and GPU fragmentation. The existing continuous batching scheduler packs by length windows but still suffers from mid-run KV evictions and tail latency spikes when long-turns collide with many short-turns. Goal: build and validate a heuristic fusion scheduler that considers three signals (recent KV residency heat, per-session turn histogram, and live latency budget) to decide prefetch vs. conservative packing and trigger opportunistic micro-defrag passes during low-util windows. Outcome: reduce 99th percentile token latency by >=15% on mixlen benchmarks and reduce KV eviction rate by >=20% without increasing average cost/token by more than 5%.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler prototype integrated into the staging runtime and toggled via feature flag
Benchmarked on mixlen-sim workload (50/50 short/long distribution) shows >=15% reduction in p99 token latency vs baseline
KV eviction rate reduced by >=20% on the same benchmark (measured as evictions per 100k tokens)
End-to-end unit cost (tokens * avg GPU seconds) increases <=5% or decreases
No regressions in throughput under steady long-turn traffic (within 3% of baseline)
Feature flag exposes tunables: heat-decay, prefetch-threshold, micro-defrag-window
notes: We intentionally avoid heavy global rearrangement; heuristic focuses on local fusion within 100ms windows to preserve latency SLOs.
Trade-offs: aggressive prefetch reduces cold-KV misses but increases transient memory pressure and may force small spill events; need conservative defaults.
Prefetch signal uses an exponential-decay heatmap keyed by session_id and model_variant; heatmap size bounded to avoid OOM.
Micro-defrag is a timed opportunistic compaction that runs when GPU utilization < 40% and KV fragmentation exceeds threshold; must be cancelable if load spikes.
We will add observability: per-session KV residency, micro-defrag triggers, prefetch hit/miss counters, and cost delta attribution in console dashboards.
